name: Camping Dreiländereck
beschreibung: The Camping Dreiländereck is located in Ried im Oberinntal, near the border with Italy and Switzerland. The site lies on a sunny terrace with mountain views in the Oberinntal. It offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents as well as rented chalets and mobile homes. The Dreiländereck is a popular excursion destination and a central starting point for tours. The surrounding area invites you to hike in the Nationalpark Stilfserjoch. The infrastructure includes a restaurant, a bread roll service and modern sanitary facilities. In winter, the ski areas Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis are easily accessible.
